correction_note: Version 1 claimed a 'second generation / depth-two continuation' step. No such step exists in the implementation. Version 2 records only the steps that actually execute.

steps_that_actually_execute.action: Generation-one exact bounded discovery with a RECURSIVE_SUBGROUP_FORK rule over parent branch (all 6 respondents) against atom X=1
Persist the child handoff to a tmp_path bundle file
Reload bundle inside a fresh Python interpreter; assert exactly one handoff
Replay retained child cohort membership against a freshly constructed synthetic repository
Compose the reloaded generation-1 handoff into a positioned-subject possibility slice and invoke the actual consumer
steps_that_actually_execute.outcome: producer_route MX01R2_RECURSIVE_TO_POSITIONED_SUBJECT; analytical_state SUPPORTED; coverage_state RECURSIVE_DEPTH_CONTINUATION; consumer EXACT_SUPPORTED

steps_that_actually_execute.action: Run the fresh-process runner twice as independent subprocesses and require byte-identical payloads

commissioned_steps_NOT_performed.detail: The recursive owner execute_exact_bounded_discovery_with_handoffs is invoked exactly once. The fresh runner re-consumes the persisted generation-1 handoff; it does not re-enter the recursive owner to produce a generation-2 handoff. 'RECURSIVE_DEPTH_CONTINUATION' is a label, not a depth-two execution.

commissioned_steps_NOT_performed.commissioned: two child predicates with lookalike visible text but different lineage must not alias
commissioned_steps_NOT_performed.detail: The hostile test test_at11_recursive_handoff_rejects_predicate_mismatch supplies a materially different predicate (X=0 instead of X=1). No fixture constructs two children with identical visible text under different parents, so the aliasing attack is untested.

coverage_distinction_note: The commissioned requirement to retain the complete discovery coverage record and explicitly distinguish handoff-selected positives from negative/unselected/unvisited coverage was not implemented. Only a single coverage_state string is emitted.
